title: CineMediaVault configuration
description: Generated from installer/config/schema.py at installer version 2.3.0 (configuration schema v1). This document describes structure and per-field constraints. The installer additionally enforces cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express - port uniqueness, module-to-library coupling, path-overlap detection, private-network enforcement and password policy - so `cinevaultctl validate` remains authoritative.

schema_version.description: Configuration schema version. Managed by the installer; do not edit.

installer_version.description: Installer version that last wrote this file.

instance_name.description: Friendly name shown in the CineMediaVault interface.

mode.description: standard = media libraries + Live TV/DVR. minimal = core web app and movies/TV only. everything = every optional module the hardware supports.

accept_licenses.description: Confirms the operator accepts the third-party licences listed in docs/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md before optional components are downloaded.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for schedules, the EPG grid and DVR padding.

full_name.description: Display name for the administrator account.

email.description: Optional contact address for the administrator account.

password.description: Administrator password. Never written to the configuration file, never logged; converted to a PBKDF2-SHA256 hash and discarded immediately. Required only when creating the account for the first time. (secret: stored in secrets.env, never in this file)

password_hash.description: Derived PBKDF2-SHA256 hash. Generated by the installer. (secret: stored in secrets.env, never in this file)

hostname.description: Hostname clients use to reach this server. Used for TLS names and for the URLs shown on the Modules page.

http_port.description: Plain HTTP port. Set enable_http to false to disable it.

enable_http.description: Serve plain HTTP in addition to HTTPS. Off by default.

https_port.description: HTTPS port. This is the primary CineMediaVault port.

tls_mode.description: self_signed = installer generates a local certificate. provided = you supply cert/key paths. acme_dns = use an existing certbot DNS-01 deployment. none = HTTP only (not recommended).

tls_key_path.description: Private key (PEM) when tls_mode is 'provided'. Never copied into backups.

trusted_networks.description: CIDR ranges allowed to reach the setup wizard and the EPG collector. Public ranges are rejected.

configure_firewall.description: Add ufw rules for the ports this install actually uses.

movies_root.description: Movie library root. Empty disables the Movies module.

tv_root.description: TV library root. Empty disables the TV module.

music_root.description: Music library root. Empty disables the Music module.

comic_library_root.description: Generated browsable comic library. Written to by the comic creators.

recordings_root.description: DVR recording destination. Must be writable and on a sized volume.

create_missing.description: Create media directories that do not exist yet. Never touches existing content; refuses paths that are not empty and not already a library.

mounts.description: Network mounts the installer should validate (and optionally add to /etc/fstab). Each entry: {type: nfs|cifs, source, mountpoint, options, credentials_file, manage_fstab}.

tmdb_api_key.description: TMDb v3 API key for movie/TV metadata and posters. (secret: stored in secrets.env, never in this file)

tmdb_read_access_token.description: TMDb v4 read access token. Either this or the API key is enough. (secret: stored in secrets.env, never in this file)

google_books_api_key.description: Optional Google Books key used by Book Vault for richer book metadata. (secret: stored in secrets.env, never in this file)

refresh_cron.description: How often the catalogue index is refreshed (systemd OnCalendar is derived from this).

fetch_on_install.description: Run a first metadata/poster fetch during installation. Off by default because a large library can take hours and hit provider rate limits.

enabled.description: Enable Live TV, the guide grid and the DVR.

discovery.description: auto = query the HDHomeRun discovery service on the LAN. manual = use the address below.

device_address.description: HDHomeRun IP address when discovery is manual.

device_id.description: HDHomeRun device ID, recorded so a replaced tuner is noticed.

tuner_count.description: Number of tuners. The DVR refuses to exceed this. 0 = read from device.

reserved_tuners.description: Tuners the DVR will never claim, so live viewing always has one free.

channels.description: Selected channel numbers. Empty = every channel the device reports.

mode.description: device_only = the tuner's own ~2-day guide. extended = additionally run the private iptv-org/epg collector on this CineVault host and append about 12 more days into one unified guide.

collector_bind_address.description: Address the EPG collector container binds. Never 0.0.0.0.

collector_port.description: Host port for the collector's read-only XMLTV feed.

feed_url.description: XMLTV URL CineMediaVault merges from. Derived from the collector settings unless you point at an existing feed.

horizon_days.description: Combined guide horizon. With the tuner's authoritative ~2 days, 14 produces approximately 12 appended days. Fourteen is the verified ceiling.

local_cache_max_age_hours.description: Maximum age of the tuner's local guide cache before CineVault refreshes it.

refresh_time.description: Local time of the daily collection run.

request_delay_ms.description: Pause between upstream requests. Lower values risk being blocked.

max_connections.description: Concurrent upstream requests. Keep at 1 to stay polite.

memory_limit_mb.description: Container memory ceiling. The grabber holds a full guide in memory.

channel_map.description: Optional verified channels.xml mapping tuner channels to upstream site IDs. Without it the collector has nothing to grab and extension stays off.

padding_end_seconds.description: Seconds to keep recording after the scheduled end.

retention_days.description: Automatic deletion age. 0 disables automatic deletion (the default).

conflict_policy.description: How the scheduler resolves more recordings than tuners.

min_free_gb.description: Recording is refused when the destination drops below this.

use_existing.description: Serve sidecar .srt files and embedded text subtitle streams.

languages.description: Language codes to discover and, when generation is on, to produce.

subdl_enabled.description: Look up missing subtitles on SubDL before falling back to Whisper.

subdl_api_key.description: SubDL API key. Stored in the root-only secret file. (secret: stored in secrets.env, never in this file)

subdl_daily_search_limit.description: Daily search cap, matching the documented free-tier limit.

whisper_enabled.description: Install the local Whisper transcription pipeline. Heavyweight: pulls a private Python environment and multi-gigabyte models.

whisper_model.description: Model size. large-v3 effectively needs a CUDA GPU.

whisper_workers.description: Concurrent transcription workers. More than 1 needs isolated scratch.

whisper_cpu_quota_percent.description: systemd CPUQuota for the worker. 200 = two cores.

whisper_start_enabled.description: Start the worker immediately after installation. Off by default so the first catalogue pass is a deliberate decision.

webex_webhook_url.description: Optional Webex incoming-webhook URL for DVR and health notifications. (secret: stored in secrets.env, never in this file)

homepage_enabled.description: Expose the counts/status JSON that Homepage dashboards consume.

transcode_control_url.description: Optional existing Transcode Control instance to link from Modules.

transcode_control_db.description: Path to a Transcode Control SQLite database. Required only for the Whisper start/stop bridge on the Modules page.

notify_on_install.description: Send one notification when installation finishes.

downloads.description: Browser and Android companion downloads, including compressed mobile copies.

games.description: Emulator modules to install: nes, sega, dos, mame, gameboy, gba, n64, ps1, c64, atari2600, atari5200, atari7800, arcade.

creators.description: Creator/generator toolchains to install: comics, books, games.

bookvault_port.description: Port the Book Vault server listens on.

comics_port.description: Port the comics library listens on.

game_port_base.description: First port for emulator modules; each one takes the next free port.

hls_enabled.description: Allow on-the-fly HLS for clients that cannot direct-play.

hls_video_bitrate.description: Target bitrate for on-the-fly conversion. 4500k suits 1080p; lower it if clients buffer over a slow link.

hls_cache_max_age_hours.description: How long converted segments are kept before the cache is swept.

default_playback_mode.description: direct plays the original file whenever the client can, which costs no CPU. hls converts everything.

library_queue_enabled.description: Install the bulk library transcode queue. Always installed STOPPED and with an empty queue: it rewrites source media and must be armed deliberately.

library_queue_autostart.description: Refused unless library_queue_enabled is true AND the operator has explicitly accepted that it modifies source media.

mobile_download_target_mb_per_hour.description: Size budget for compressed downloads to phones, per hour of video. The server refuses a result that overshoots this or that grows larger than the source.

app_memory_limit_mb.description: systemd MemoryMax for the main service.

app_cpu_quota_percent.description: systemd CPUQuota for the main service. 0 = unlimited.

scan_worker_threads.description: Threads used by library scans and thumbnail generation.

enabled.description: Generate a spoken-narration promo reel (Kokoro TTS + ffmpeg) previewing upcoming virtual-channel programming on a timer. Requires vchannels.enabled and the two Kokoro model files supplied by the operator (see docs/PROMO-BARKER-CHANNEL.md); nothing is downloaded automatically.

model_path.description: Path to the operator-supplied kokoro-v1.0.onnx weights file. Required when promo_channel.enabled is true.

voices_path.description: Path to the operator-supplied voices-v1.0.bin voice pack. Required when promo_channel.enabled is true.

schedule_calendar.description: systemd OnCalendar expression for reel generation. Default: four times a day, one hour before each 6-hour broadcast boundary.

cpu_quota_percent.description: systemd CPUQuota for the render timer.

memory_limit_mb.description: systemd MemoryMax for the render timer.

log_level.description: How much detail the installer and services write to their logs.

log_retain_days.description: Days of rotated logs to keep before they are deleted.

db_backup_time.description: Local time of the nightly database backup. Keep it clear of the EPG collection window so the two do not compete for disk.

db_backup_keep.description: Number of database backups to retain. Older ones are pruned automatically; at least one is always kept.

health_check_enabled.description: Run a health probe every minute and restart the service if it stops answering.

health_failure_threshold.description: Consecutive failed probes before a restart. Do not set this to 1: a single stalled probe on a busy server is normal, and restarting on it would interrupt playback and mask real failures.

health_restart_cooldown_seconds.description: Minimum seconds between two health-triggered restarts. Stops a restart storm when the service dies again immediately.

session_days.description: How long a signed-in browser session stays valid.

poster_rotation_seconds.description: How often the home and sign-in background artwork changes. The selection is cached so a restart does not rotate it early.

install_root.description: Where the application itself is installed. Root-owned and never writable by the service.

state_root.description: Databases, generated metadata, artwork and backups.

cache_root.description: Regenerable caches: HLS segments, subtitles, mobile downloads. Safe to delete when the service is stopped.

service_user.description: Unprivileged system account the services run as.

service_group.description: Group that may read the secret files.
